controls.label: Color
controls.qualification: Color of a blackbody at the star's temperature; darkening toward the edge from a model atmosphere. The disc itself is unresolved.
controls.notes: The color of a blackbody at the star's published temperature. The darkening toward the edge is the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 4,750 K and log g 1.2 (u1 0.690, u2 0.098): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used. The spin axis's direction on the sky is a display convention.

controls.label: Pulsation

controls.notes: KQ Sco at maximum light, phase 0.0 of one 28.7-day pulsation: its color dimmed to 100% of its light at maximum, as Gaia DR3's published G-band model of the star gives it. The 10 steps are a tenth of a period apart (a display choice); the model between them is continuous. The star's color and size also change through the cycle and are not drawn: nothing here measures them. The played light curve (the Light curves switch) is not drawn over these steps: each already holds its own light.
